descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在巴塞罗那尝过番茄面包后留下的菜单。名字写得慢，旁边的红色添得很快。
descriptions.en: My menu after tomato bread in Barcelona. The name took time; the touches of tomato red were much quicker.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在巴塞罗那吃过的焦糖奶冻，菜单旁边有小勺子和音符，记着那份糖壳轻轻裂开的一声。
descriptions.en: The crema catalana I tried in Barcelona, with a spoon and tiny musical note for the small crack of that serving's sugar crust.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在巴塞罗那桂尔公园长椅的一处弯边歇脚后，我留下的个人记号，不是座位号码。
descriptions.en: A personal note after resting by a curve in Park Güell's bench in Barcelona. It marks a memory, not a seat number.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在巴塞罗那吃焦糖奶冻时，我给自己那份薄壳裂开声画的小音符。旁边有勺子，免得认成歌单。
descriptions.en: A musical note for the crack of my crema catalana crust in Barcelona, with a spoon beside it to keep it off the song list.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 参观巴塞罗那加泰罗尼亚音乐宫后，我在外面记下的小圆，保存望向中央天窗的那一眼。
descriptions.en: A small circle I noted outside after visiting Barcelona's Palau de la Música Catalana, keeping a glance toward the central skylight.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我为巴塞罗那音乐宫那次参观做的折页。暖色小圆藏在里面，展开时才读得到“记得抬头”。
descriptions.en: My homemade fold from a visit to the Palau in Barcelona. A warm circle waits inside with the words “Remember to look up.”
